channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An old AI module was removed and the storage backup system was upgraded, while cleanup processes for cold storage were improved. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: A new way to retrieve payout addresses was added, lockout scenarios for investors were introduced, and a numeric keypad component was added to the interface. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The milestone audit was completed, payout address getters were added, and earnings reports now include real job counts. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Security was enhanced with password hashing and rotating tokens, and the build system was forced to use internal servers; the dashboard design was updated for better accessibility. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was fixed and new tests were added to verify the changes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
